title: Cream Assistant Phone on Giant Ghost Name
whatItIs: A wide cream cover with a giant faint 'Niva' behind a phone showing 'How can I help you today?' with chips, a blue-to-orange gradient arc and an Ask Niva field with a blue mic button, with upcoming activity cards peeking below.
whatItMeans: The huge faint name fills the frame quietly and the warm gradient arc is a friendly focus.
techniques: Gradient arc as the assistant's signature
Blue voice button as a cool accent
Cream fading to white at the base

vocabulary.definition: Oversized faint brand text behind a subject.
A microphone button for speaking a request.
Cards partly visible below the fold.
